variants.name: EntranceMound
variants.collider: mesh collider (Earth + Floor); Root/Props details: no collider
variants.pivot: z = 0 is the outside ground level, XY = bounds centre. Base skirt and throat floor go below 0 (sink into terrain).
variants.mouth: opening faces -Y; mouth centre at x = -0.42
variants.notes: v2 details: roots across the lip + rootlets, ~48 sticks, 20 needle bundles, pebbles/clods in slopes, ~45 leaves, 10 ant holes, clods rolled to the foot, flat crumbs on the throat floor. Heap with steep hood over the mouth, low right shoulder, 3 foot lumps; boolean-cut throat descending ~0.7 m (<= 16 deg) to a dark end (Props dark); 11 lobed dry leaves conformed to the surface
